producer_report.summary: Added crates/athena-testutil: write_executable (temp name, close, chmod, rename), a run helper that retries on ETXTBSY, and a stress test. Every listed test now writes its stand-in through it, including the athena-git snapshot test. In that test the script is only committed, not run. CHANGELOG.md records the change. docs/architecture.md gained one row for the new crate; it is not on the deliverables list.

checks_run.note: 56 git tests and 2 testutil tests pass, including the stress test

criteria_check.criterion: A single shared helper (new crate under crates/, listed in workspace Cargo.toml and as a dev-dependency) writes executable scripts via temp file, close, chmod, rename; Grep shows no remaining write-then-from_mode(0o755) stand-in pattern in xtask/src/main.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/reconcile.rs, crates/athena-agent/src/claude.rs, crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs, crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs tests.
criteria_check.evidence: I grepped for from_mode(0o7 across the repo. The only hits are the helper's own chmod in crates/athena-testutil/src/lib.rs and the non-test set_permissions in xtask/src/main.rs (line ~809), which is out of scope. The six listed test sites now call athena_testutil::write_executable. athena-git was the one I had missed earlier: I replaced its set_permissions in snapshot.rs and added the dev-dependency to crates/athena-git/Cargo.toml. cargo test -p athena-git passes.

criteria_check.criterion: A stress test in the helper crate writes and runs scripts many times (e.g. 200) while other threads repeatedly fork/spawn processes, and every run succeeds with no ETXTBSY; run `cargo test` and it passes.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran cargo test -p athena-testutil. runs_succeed_while_other_threads_fork passes.

criteria_check.criterion: All existing tests still pass: `cargo test --workspace` passes and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` is clean and `cargo fmt --check` passes.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran cargo fmt --all --check myself and it passed.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing only what the diff does (shared stand-in helper, listed tests moved onto it, ETXTBSY retry, stress test), with no unrelated claims.
criteria_check.evidence: CHANGELOG.md is modified. I did not re-read its text this round, only the earlier entry I wrote for the helper, the moved tests, the retry and the stress test. snapshot.rs was already among the listed tests.

criteria_check.criterion: The helper has doc comments explaining the ETXTBSY cause for an outside reader, and the diff touches only the helper crate, workspace/dev-dependency manifests, the listed tests, Cargo.lock and CHANGELOG.md.
criteria_check.evidence: The doc comments are in crates/athena-testutil/src/lib.rs. The diff touches the helper crate, manifests, the listed tests, Cargo.lock and CHANGELOG.md. The one extra file is a one-row crate table entry in docs/architecture.md. I kept it because the policy test dependency_direction_matches_the_architecture passes with it. I did not try removing it to see whether the test fails.

open_issues: docs/architecture.md is outside the stated file list. Athena should check whether the new crate row there is wanted.
mistakes: The first round left crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs unchanged. It is now moved onto the helper.
learnings: The athena-git snapshot test only commits the script and never runs it; using the helper there still removes the leftover from_mode pattern.
docs/architecture.md lists every crate in a table that a policy test checks.
